assumptions: Every input is digested by the same enzymes throughout the reaction.
limits: Enumerates products, not yields; a finished construct is one with no sites of the first enzyme left.
bio.jane/contract.question: What products survive a one-pot restriction-ligation, where re-formed sites are cut again?

description: Cut and ligate in ONE POT (pydna restriction_ligation_assembly): every input is digested by the same enzymes inside the reaction and the pieces are joined as they appear, so a junction that re-forms a recognition site can be cut again. This is the reaction Golden Gate is a special case of, and it is a different chemistry from ligate_fragments, which digests first and then ligates whatever the digest left. Reports how many sites of the FIRST enzyme each product still carries — a finished construct has none.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

blunt.description: allow blunt-end joins as well as sticky.

end_origins.description: what MADE each input's ends, positionally. In a one-pot reaction almost every end is cut INSIDE the tube and is therefore freshly 5'-phosphorylated, so this changes the answer only for an input's own original terminus — reachable only when it arrives already sticky, which today means an annealed oligo adapter. Advanced.

end_treatments.description: the phosphatase or kinase applied to each input, positionally. Same reach as `end_origins`: an original sticky terminus only. Advanced.

enzymes.description: the enzymes in the pot — used for every input. Left unset, the run uses your active enzyme collection.

fragments.description: the molecules to put in the pot — wire upstream `record` outputs here, or name library documents.

include_subject.description: also put the node's subject in the pot.

sort_by_recognition_sites.description: sort products by how many sites of the FIRST enzyme they still carry, fewest first — this floats the finished construct to the top.

name: restriction_ligate

junctions.description: the junctions formed, with the overhang each was made by — wire into score_overhang_fidelity

layout.description: where each piece and join sits ON the product: the spans the map draws

nickedJunctions.description: indices of junctions left NICKED by a missing 5'-phosphate on one strand — the product still transforms and is repaired in vivo

partiallyDigested.description: inputs whose products were DROPPED because they would have needed a partial digest — a product that needs the enzyme to skip a site it must have cut is not a bench outcome

productCount.description: number of products (>1 = the pieces go together more than one way)

recognitionSites.description: sites of the FIRST enzyme still in the first product. 0 = finished: the reaction cannot re-cut it

record.description: the first product, as a record — with the sort on, the one carrying the fewest remaining sites
